summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for the 2026/27 season with just one week to go, welcoming several new signings and returnees to the squad alongside three brand new kits. The team recently played a tight match against St Helens, though they were edged out despite both sides playing well. If you're interested in sponsoring the club, now's the time to get in touch as they look to support the Ramblers' promotion push!
